controlLoops.finding: Placement readiness has conservative immediate loss, but no freshness coordinate and no asymmetric recovery damping.
Single-owner fencing works. Response-loss recovery converges when Runtime honors exact clientRequest replay; otherwise Agent Service cannot discover the orphan external Job.
Replay/failover exactness and historical-success fencing converge, but fallback diversity is not modeled.
Credential proof freshness is rechecked before material resolution on each call.

nonActions: Do not create a second Runtime execution ledger in Agent Service.
Do not add generic symmetric hysteresis to readiness before observation freshness is preserved.
Do not make same-host fallback universally illegal; failure-domain semantics need domain/provider evidence.
Do not weaken immediate fail-closed credential expiry checks.
Do not change R12 quiescence/replay-safety separation.

recommendedOrder.action: Propagate a monotonic natural-provider observation coordinate from the materialization ledger through census and CarrierProviderAdapter into Agent Service; reject stale regressions/recoveries before changing readiness.
recommendedOrder.name: FRESHNESS_CONSERVATION
recommendedOrder.whyBeforeHysteresis: Damping without freshness can preserve obsolete READY evidence longer.

recommendedOrder.action: After freshness exists, test immediate downgrade plus delayed/stable re-upgrade rather than symmetric hysteresis.
recommendedOrder.name: ASYMMETRIC_READINESS_DAMPING_EXPERIMENT

recommendedOrder.action: Derive provider/account/host/network/credential failure-domain evidence for primary/fallback comparisons without creating a universal FailureDomain authority yet.
recommendedOrder.name: FAILURE_DOMAIN_DERIVATION

recommendedOrder.action: Require new retry/recovery features to declare the unique layer owning replay, backoff and cancellation.
recommendedOrder.name: CONTROLLER_OWNERSHIP_GATE

sourceFindings.meaning: The current local Runtime satisfies the exact-replay dependency exposed by S4; Agent Service should not duplicate Runtime execution truth.
